depicted_variant: Varian berukuran manusia besar, satu mata di dahi dan mulut raksasa di perut, bulu merah kusut dan kaki terbalik.

visual_requirements.description: Satu mata di dahi, mulut besar di tengah perut, bulu kemerahan panjang, dua tangan berkuku kait, dua kaki yang menghadap belakang.
Menerkam dari cahaya redup hutan, tanpa efek bau berwarna atau aura.

aura: Satu mata, mulut perut dan kaki terbalik c20 serta terkam c10 menyampaikan bahaya tanpa efek generik (klaim: mapinguari-c10).
artistic_choices: Dipilih satu mata dahi c20, bukan mata perut c04; tanpa mulut kedua di wajah.
Ukuran manusia besar dari c20, kamera rapat rendah; bukan raksasa tanpa pembanding.
Bulu penuh menutup tubuh; tidak menampilkan korban, bau sebagai kabut, atau tembakan.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of MAPINGUARI, the Brazilian forest being in its single forehead eye and belly mouth variant.
ANATOMY: one head with EXACTLY ONE large eye centred in the forehead, NO second eye and NO face mouth; huge open tooth-lined mouth in the middle of the BELLY; body covered in long shaggy REDDISH fur; TWO arms with hook-shaped nails, TWO legs, BOTH feet anatomically reversed: the HEELS face FORWARD toward the viewer and the TOES with nails extend BEHIND the calves AWAY from viewer, soles point down; large human body size. [mapinguari-c02, mapinguari-c20]
MOMENT: lunging from the deep forest toward us, single eye fixed on viewer, belly mouth wide open, arms spread and curled hook nails reaching, both backward feet readable in a side three-quarter stance: the feet point back behind its body, toes and nails visibly extend toward the rear, two blunt HEELS face the foreground. Neither foot may point toes toward the camera.
POWER: physical ambush and terrible scream; no visible magic and no stench cloud. Leaves scatter from the movement. [mapinguari-c10]
SCALE & CAMERA: ground-level extreme low angle, frame includes both reversed feet, clearly showing heel pads in the foreground and toes pointing backward, and dominates from feet to head; tight foreshortened full-body portrait, no giant scale exaggeration.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one late sun shaft from a break in the canopy, deep warm black shadows, plain damp haze.
SURFACE: thick matted rust-red fur, dark rough skin around the single eye and belly jaws, muddy feet, mossy roots.
SETTING: dim deep forest. [mapinguari-c10]
MOOD: dangerous and imposing, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: square at least 1024px; no text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons.

rejected_attempts.reason: Kaki terbalik c20 tidak terbaca jelas: kaki kiri layar menyerupai jari menghadap penonton, kaki kanan menyamping. Uji anatomi gagal meski mata tunggal/mulut perut dan ancaman bagus.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: PNG asli percobaan kedua dilihat: tepat satu mata dahi dan satu mulut perut, dua lengan berkuku kait dan dua kaki terbalik. Tumit menghadap depan/penonton, jari berkuku memanjang ke sisi-belakang kedua kaki; tidak ada mulut wajah. Bulu merah, terkam, latar hutan c20/c10 jelas. Semua tujuh Uji Sangar ya; ancaman pada thumbnail kuat. Percobaan1 diarsip karena orientasi kaki samar. Tanpa efek supernatural/teks/gore. Kontak thumbnail asli berukuran200 piksel dilihat ulang bersama13 PNG lane-A; ciri subjek dan kesan sangar/agung tetap terbaca.

root_visual_review.notes: Shaggy red one-eyed giant with a huge fanged mouth in its belly and hooked claws lunging through dim forest; feet are not clearly reversed, otherwise every documented part is readable.
